name: gpt-oss-120b
_comment_n_kv: HF config sets head_dim=64 explicitly (not H/n_q=45). True KV/token = 2 * 8 * 64 * b = 1024b. Framework infers d_head=H/n_q=45, so we adjust n_kv from 8 to 11 to recover H_kv ≈ 8 * 64 = 512 (n_kv=11 gives 495, ~3% under). Attention FLOPs are approximate.
_comment_bytes_per_param: MXFP4 quantization (quant_method=mxfp4 in HF config) → b=0.5. The HF converter defaults to b=2 (BF16); overridden here to match the deployed precision.
_comment_moe: All 36 layers are MoE (no dense layers). 128 experts per layer, top-k=4. I_moe = intermediate_size = 2880. SwiGLU activation.
_comment: The input embedding and the LM head are separate matrices in the published weights (`tied_embeddings` false), so memory holds two vocabulary matrices. The published config has 64 query heads and 8 key/value heads of width 64 with hidden size 2880, so heads are wider than H / n_q: `head_dim` 64 and `n_kv` 8 give the exact key/value width of 512 (the earlier `n_kv` 11 approximated it as 495) and query/output projections of 2880 x 4096.
_comment_attention_window: Every other layer (18 of 36, starting with the first) uses sliding-window attention over the last 128 tokens; the rest attend to the whole context (layer_types and sliding_window of the published config). A window layer keeps and reads a cache of at most 128 tokens and scores at most 128 positions per query.
